# sfcompute_account (Data Source)

Reads account from SF Compute (`GET /preview/v2/me`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sfcompute_account" "me" {}

output "account" {
  value = data.sfcompute_account.me.account_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) The account identifier.
- `created_at` (Number) When the account was created, as a Unix epoch timestamp in seconds.
- `entity_type` (String) Whether the account is for personal use or a business, or `null` if it hasn't been set yet.
- `user` (Attributes) The logged-in user that issued the calling token. `null` when authenticated with a service token, which acts on behalf of the account rather than an individual user. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--user))

<a id="nestedatt--user"></a>
### Nested Schema for `user`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp.
- `email` (String) The member's primary email, or `null` if they have no recorded email identity.
- `first_name` (String) The member's first name, or `null` if not recorded.
- `id` (String)
- `last_name` (String) The member's last name, or `null` if not recorded.
- `resource_path` (String) A resource path for a user resource. Format: sfc:user:<name>.
